name: Eisklettern im Kaunertal
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The frozen waterfall in the **Kaunertal** is a must-visit for ice climbers. Under the guidance of a state-certified mountain guide, you’ll swing your ice axes and ascend the shimmering ice face. Beginner courses teach the essential techniques, and the thrill of reaching the summit of the waterfall is unforgettable.
